snippet.title: Beaten Path - Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Strategy, story, and spectacle converge in this character-driven journey.

Support now on Kickstarter, late pledges are available:  https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/peacebreakstudio/beaten-path-turn-based-tactical-rpg
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584400/Beaten_Path
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/Ncmj2mXB
